metadata.title: Software for Why can equal results lead to different scientific futures
metadata.description: Finite mathematical separation and compact sufficient repair, with distinct retained coefficient-successor and known-proof completion records. Original comparisons, failures, truncation, unknown-request status and separately authorised supplementary observations are preserved. The software provides one-command deterministic raw-data reanalysis and offline ordinary Lean replay of five unchanged candidates, with packaged Linux x86_64 Python/Lean environments. No new experimental model sampling; no independent-kernel certification. Third-party rights and notices remain in force.
